remarks: Welcome to your private countryside retreat, nestled on an incredible 60-acre wooded parcel featuring a large scenic pond, rolling landscapes, and endless opportunities for recreation, relaxation, and outdoor living. This charming three-bedroom, two-bathroom home offers the perfect blend of modern upgrades and rustic comfort, creating an ideal escape for nature lovers, hunters, hobby farmers, or anyone seeking peace and privacy. Step inside to discover a spacious, light-filled interior designed for comfortable everyday living. The beautifully renovated kitchen serves as the heart of the home, showcasing solid maple countertops, modern cabinetry, and durable vinyl flooring that flows throughout. A dedicated dining area seamlessly connects to the inviting living space, where a stunning stone-surrounded gas fireplace creates a warm and welcoming focal point. Large windows frame picturesque views of the surrounding acreage and pond, bringing the beauty of the outdoors inside. Exposed wooden beams add character and rustic charm, enhancing the home's cozy atmosphere. Both bathrooms have been thoughtfully updated with stylish vanities and new plumbing fixtures. Additional improvements include new drywall and insulation throughout, providing enhanced comfort and energy efficiency year-round. Outside, the property truly shines. The expansive 60 acres offer a rare combination of open space, wooded areas, and a large pond, creating a spectacular setting for fishing, wildlife watching, ATV trails, hunting, hiking, or simply enjoying the serenity of your own private oasis. Gather around the outdoor fire pit on summer evenings and take in the breathtaking natural surroundings. Additional features include a one-car garage with electric and heat, as well as a storage shed for tools, equipment, and outdoor gear. Offering a unique combination of updated living space, remarkable acreage, and a beautiful pond, this exceptional property provides the best of country living while remaining conveniently close to local amenities and all that Ellicottville has to offer. Square footage does not match county records and is based on appraiser measurements.
